commands: cd web && npm run generate && npm test -- --runInBand
preserved_assertions: All three original native fixtures, snapshots, ten board profiles and Web/engine scenarios remain. Split capacity assertions change from the invalid documented 256 to 240 on both roles.
review_matrix: Five real-kernel topology/relay roles/layouts, normal plus ASan/UBSan; build each of ten variants once and execute it three times with fresh working state.
negative_controls: tests/review_negative_control.py; executable assertions required except wired-size, which intentionally requires the selected core's compile-time envelope rejection. inner-worker requires ASan.
gaps: Physical USB/BLE/wired split, GPIO/electrical ghosting, timing, power and interruption of blocked core TX require matching device evidence.
